Dear Zoltán 
Thank you for the review::))

Very kind and competent service, fair prices. I get satisfactory answers to all my questions about feeding, vitamins or nutritional supplements. When I ask about equipment, he gives me useful advice. It's really nice that he gets to know me when I go (about every 2-3 weeks) and knows what kind of dog I have. He remembers what I brought last time. I come here from Dunaharaszti, but I prefer to drive a little more because it's nice to come here.

I'm so glad I found them. I'll only shop with them from now on.
Expertise, cooperation, help, endless patience. If you need a reliable place, I sincerely recommend them.
